title: Shared AI credit pool
description: The pool is well under the reset threshold, so the health bar shows healthy progress without immediately nearing a hard stop.

title: User-level budget (ULB)
description: The user has consumed most of the individual budget, which is a useful warning state before a hard stop is reached.

title: Cost-center budget
description: This is a typical cost-center warning state where the next event would push the budget to its cap.

title: Org budget near cap
description: At 90% the health badge is elevated, and a single additional simulation step would reach 100% if the same usage pattern continues.

title: User budget at the threshold
description: This is the clearest demonstration of the next-step saturation case: the next simulation event would push the bar to 100% and trigger a hard-stop condition when the budget is enforced.
